{{Otheruses|Water}}
A '''Water Complex''' was a type of [[Complex]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Water Complexes added the [[Water/Legends|water]] hazards and obstacles. The [[Luzitall]] and [[Tarkin's Shears]] were both Water Complexes.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
